learning: Check whether line_loss_events on the s-bend and slalom fall toward 0 and whether max_error drops below 0.06 m. If oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.25, the next step is sensor y 0.05 to 0.03. If line loss is gone but rms_error stays above 0.03, try sensor_size 0.012 with 7 sensors. Report per-track values.
notes: Adopts the Builder's ±0.08 m span and 0.016 m footprint unchanged. Weights scaled to x/0.04 so sensitivity matches iteration 1. kd raised to 0.8 because oval oscillation was 0.267 in iteration 2.
rationale: Iteration 2 (±0.06 m span, 0.012 m footprints) scored 272.25. The oval finished 55% of trials, but the s-bend and slalom still ended off_track with 0.6 and 0.95 line-loss events per run and max_error at the 0.06 m floor. Line loss persisted at the outer edge, so I adopt the Builder's ±0.08 m span at 0.04 m spacing. The Builder's 0.016 m footprint leaves a 24 mm gap, which the 25 mm tape bridges. The sensor weights are scaled to x/0.04, giving [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2], which keeps the same signal sensitivity per metre as iteration 1 and stays inside the ±2 weight limit. kp stays at 6 and base_speed at 1.5. Oval steering_oscillation was 0.267 in iteration 2, above the 0.25 threshold, so kd rises from 0.7 to 0.8 for damping. I keep sensor y at 0.05 for now so the span change can be read cleanly. Expected: line_loss_events fall on the s-bend and slalom, and max_error drops below 0.06 m. Risks: the wider array may add oscillation, and the 0.016 m footprint may coarsen rms_error.
